title: Trump Blames Minnesota, Not Iran, for Cyberattack, Despite Initial Investigation
summary: President Trump claimed without evidence that Minnesota’s Democratic government was “behind” a cyberattack on the state’s own water systems. Investigators believe Iran is likely responsible.
